verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's own API docs say its Cloud APIs can be used via REST or official client libraries in popular programming languages, which is the core of the story. The evidence for this is a single short repeated statement, not in-depth SDK documentation. missing for 10: a list of the specific supported languages and SDK reference docs, evidence of SDK depth or quality for agentic workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs.
